The '''Jedi Restoration Concord''' was an organization founded by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Syo Bakarn]] around [[3653 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Sometime before [[3645 BBY]],<ref name="The Defector">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Defector|Abandoned Mining Facility}}</ref><ref name="The Merciful One">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Merciful One|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> the Concord helped the people of the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Uphrades]] to double their [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] food production over the course of two [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. As a result of his leadership in the Concord's efforts, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] granted Bakarn a seat on the Council.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Concord was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
